rationale: Seven materially non-trivial, seed-stable GAIN faults survive capacity matching, comparable pre-fault FPR, and hierarchical paired run-level uncertainty, while 21 faults remain no-gain; this supports only a falsifiable mechanism experiment.

kill_criteria.evidence: 7 materially non-trivial faults retain a positive direction in at least 4/5 seeds against both controls.
7/8 (87.5%) material F1-v-F0 gains retain material and statistically supported headroom over F0-C.

kill_criteria.criterion: apparent gains disappear after run-level uncertainty analysis
kill_criteria.evidence: 7 material faults retain positive hierarchical paired-bootstrap AUROC intervals against both controls.

next_step: Run only a separately approved, prespecified mechanism experiment on the stable GAIN and no-gain groups. Do not lock the thesis topic from Experiment 1 alone.

classification_rule.gain: Mean ?AUROC >= 0.02 and mean ?AUPRC >= 0.01 against both F0 and F0-C; AUROC positive in >=4/5 seeds; seed-level and hierarchical paired-run AUROC 95% CIs above zero against both; pre-fault-FPR paired bootstrap CI within +/-0.005.
classification_rule.degraded: Seed-level AUROC 95% CIs below zero against both controls and paired-run AUROC CI below zero against F0.
